discoveredComplexity: An index that is maintained by only some of the processes writing the bucket has to survive every state the others leave, and each such state is a separate way to lose a delivery: a record rewritten without the field, a record created without it, and a record held under a claim written without it. The first two were found in round 1's review and this round's; the third is this round's, and it is the one the adoption rule alone did not reach, because the sweep returns on a live claim before it reaches any write.

A build can tell that another build has swept by what the other build does not write. The cursor is the one key every sweep writes, so a field this build always sets turns the cursor into that signal, and a rollback stops hiding behind the back-fill's marker.

A margin against another writer's clock must also cover the resolution of what it compares. The entries are keyed to the minute, so a margin of cursorOverlap proved only that a write was older than cursorOverlap minus a minute; the margin has to carry that minute itself.
